newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Societe Generale net profit up six percent.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Societe Generale net profit up six percent.

text.p: Societe Generale de Belgique, Belgium's flagship holding company, said on Tuesday net profit in the six months to June 30, 1996 rose to 6.72 billion francs ($213.9 million) from 6.34 billion in the same period of 1995.
Profits from ordinary activities, current profit, rose by five percent to 6.31 billion from 6.01 billion.
Extraordinary gains in the first half amounted to 410 million francs, up 24 percent from 330 million in the first half of last year.
SGB said it expected full-year 1996 current profit to match 1995's, but net profit to rise.

"In the present economic and monetary climate group net income on ordinary activities in 1996 should be at least up to the 1995 level. Its net profit, on the other hand, will be higher," SGB said in a statement on first-half earnings.
